title: Fallback variant compatibility: ongoing audit, remediation workflow and scorecard
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Goal: Establish a repeatable audit + remediation workflow for fallback model variants so that region/tier routing can safely fall back with no tokenizer/context/tooling regressions. Scope includes tokenizer parity checks, KV cache context compatibility, runtime hooks/tooling shims, and CI gating. Acceptance criteria: (1) compatibility scorecard defined and stored in the compatibility catalog, (2) a lightweight smoke-test suite that runs in CI for every variant pair, (3) an automated alert when compatibility score drops below threshold for customer-impacting routes, (4) remediation playbook with clear owners and PR templates.
updates: 2025-11-05 - Triage: ticket opened after ops incident where US->EU fallback caused tokenization mismatch for legacy v0.9 variant. Assigned to Marcus Lee. High customer impact flagged.

2025-11-06 - Discovery: ran cross-variant tokenizer diff harness across top-20 fallback pairs; identified 3 pairs with >2% tokenization divergence on canonical prompt set. Links: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/compatibility/ENG-73456

2025-11-07 - Decision: adopt compatibility score model (tokenizer parity, KV context alignment, tooling shim version) with weighting 50/30/20. Documented scoring in doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Variant+Compatibility+Scorecard

2025-11-08 - Action: added CI job 'compat-smoke' to runtime repo. Initial PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6712 (experimental). Smoke suite runs tokenizer diffs on 200 canonical prompts and checks KV cache replay for 4-step sequences.

2025-11-10 - Findings: KV replay failures for model variant m-1.12-fp16 when context length > 4096 due to truncated KV serialization; started remediation branch runtime:fix/kv-serialization-compat (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6728).

2025-11-12 - Review: design review with DX (Anika Patel) about adding a compatibility tag in the model catalog UI. PM (Liam O'Connor) requested feature toggles for canary-enforced fallbacks. Next: finalize score thresholds and add automated alerting rule in console.
Blockers: need model team sign-off on tolerance thresholds for tokenization differences. Waiting on model-onboarding team availability (owner: Priya Desai).
acceptance_criteria: compatibility scorecard stored in catalog and visible in console
compat-smoke CI job added and green on main for all variant pairs in the catalog
automated alert rule created when a variant pair falls below threshold
remediation playbook with PR templates and rollback steps documented
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: false positives from tokenizer diffs leading to blocked rollouts. Mitigation: threshold tuning and human review step before blocking canaries.
Risk: KV cache format drift across builds. Mitigation: enforce serialization compatibility tests and add a compatibility tag that blocks incompatible snapshots.
Risk: Tooling shim version mismatch in private deployments. Mitigation: add shim version detection to deployment agent and surface as warning in console.
implementation_notes: Add a new field 'compatibility_score' to the model catalog metadata (stringified numeric value for now).
Extend existing eval harness to produce tokenizer-diff artifacts and a normalized delta metric (percent token split).
Create automation that annotates model variants with 'compat:ok'|'compat:warn'|'compat:fail' tags used by routing policy engine.
PR templates: use labels [compat-audit] and include summary of tokenizer diffs + KV replay logs + suggested remediation.
